# RC2: repair the three affected owner-test fixtures

The previous ABG-owned intake increment adds early enforcement of the existing native assessment role relation. Its actual isolated build passed, all five new intake cases passed, all six selected C2 guard/budget cases passed, and the fresh native UAT Return is satisfied for that bounded increment with explicit residuals. The input evidence retains the actual Returns and identities; do not upgrade that to full owner-suite or release qualification.

Construction identified two existing fixture helpers that reuse one path as source, candidate and rubric. Their three affected cases need lawful disjoint role selections under the current intake predicate:
- t287-native-work-reacquisition.test.mjs: declarationFixture, used by `library prepare-testing reuses the invoking private operation and its actual F_D origin` and `library Testing first-refusal diagnostics distinguish actual nullable owner relations without changing guards`.
- t287-native-work-currentness-consumers.test.mjs: governanceInput, used by `U1-P5-02 actual C0 successor and every affected currentness consumer`.

Repair only these fixture declarations and any directly necessary fixture setup/expectations in the same two files. Preserve the actual owner calls, physical currentness checks, causal identity and provenance checks, positive and negative assertions, and the precise behavior each case exercises. Materialize or bind distinct inputs if the exercised owner requires them. Do not replace real owner work with mocks, skip cases, loosen assertions or time limits, or weaken the new intake guard. If the repair reveals a genuine Product counterexample or needs another owner file, return that exact dependency. This is fixture maintenance, not a Product redesign.

The exact write grant is those two test files and the existing task note. All Product/implementation/GTL source, the previous C2 diagnostic files, the new intake tests and their constraints remain unchanged. Construction may do read-only/in-memory checks; it must not run a canonical build or write generated outputs. Testing owns the actual isolated build and executable proof. No network, dependency installation, parallel work or invented evidence.

The declared C2 plan copies the fixed offline toolchain and immutable seed contracts, builds the unchanged Product with the updated fixture source present, runs the five intake cases, then runs exactly the three named affected cases across the two files. The build creates the isolated test environment; it does not grant new release or whole-product credit. All commands, exits, streams and counts must be actual. UAT independently assesses every supplied criterion against these current files and admitted observations. Source, candidate and rubric roles are distinct in this input.

Method/frame: selected STDO 3.0.2, one bounded owner-fixture maintenance increment under the current RC1-to-RC2 operator trial. Product retains one event-log authority, declared effects and separate construction/assessment. Relevant Product source is specification/PRODUCT.md (selected material and assessment; recovery preserves evidence); owning HOW is T287_DEFAULT_GOVERNANCE_LIBRARY_DESIGN.md and T287_NATIVE_WORKSPACE_WORK_DESIGN.md. Their existing validation/causal boundaries stand.

Keep explicit residuals: the prior full C2 owner-file run timed out at two internal 180 s cases and the 600 s outer limit; that suite is not rerun or claimed here. Canonical generated-file deletions still need reconciliation through ABG before a cut. Full owner-suite acceptance, fifteen-family qualification, model-identity independence, installed-CLI early-refusal proof and RC2 release readiness remain open. Preserve all valid existing evidence without representing historical passes as current execution.
